findings: mj_step first calls mj_forward at current state with sensors enabled.
RK4 intermediate stages call mj_forwardSkip with skipsensor=1, so none overwrites sensordata.
Final RK4 advance updates physical state/time but does not recompute sensors; sensordata remains pre-action.
MJPC copies those pre-action residuals immediately after mj_step. Terminal residual uses direct mj_forward at terminal state.
Adapter C/D finite differences read exactly those pre-action sensors, including C-only terminal evaluation.
Interior/one-sided boundary gold using after-step sensors therefore tests intended sensor map; shared timing error not found.
